resources.string: Saves your look, wallpaper, dock and hidden apps to a file you can restore later or copy to another TV.
%1$d settings in this file, %2$d will be skipped.
No backups in Download/GlassLauncher yet. Export one first, or copy a backup file there.
Lets Glass list backups it did not save itself, such as files copied from another TV.
That file is too big to be a settings backup (64 KB at most).
That file is damaged or is not a settings backup.
That file is not a Glass Launcher settings backup.
That backup was made by a newer Glass Launcher. Update the app, then try again.
That backup has no settings Glass can use.
Could not save the backup. Check that the TV has free storage.
This TV has no shared storage and no file picker, so backups cannot be saved or opened here.
Glass needs storage access to save the backup in the Download folder.
